title: fea.materialAssignment
summary: Assign a RunMat FEA material to a region.
description: `fea.materialAssignment(region, material, Name, Value, ...)` creates an exact region-to-material assignment with optional expected-material and evidence-confidence metadata.
behaviors: Region, assigned material, and optional expected material are exact text identifiers.
Confidence is an enumerated structural value and defaults to verified.
No numeric field exists; integer and resident numeric inputs are rejected before assignment construction.
Region existence and material consistency are checked when the assignment is assembled into or validated with a model.

faqs.question: Does construction prove the region exists?
faqs.answer: No. Construction preserves the selector; model assembly and validation resolve it against geometry.
